wageDefinition.en: Annual wage or salary income (ACS WAGP, inflation-adjusted with ADJINC). Full-time (35+ h/week), year-round (50+ weeks) civilian employees aged 18-69.
wageDefinition.ja: 年間の賃金・給与収入（ACS の WAGP を ADJINC で物価調整）。フルタイム（週35時間以上）かつ通年（50週以上）勤務の18〜69歳の文民就業者。
